reviews.title: Appalling website design - impossible to find the Log Out button!
reviews.body:
Review Title: Appalling website design - impossible to find the Log Out button!

As an elderly, low-usage customer, I am incredibly frustrated by the terrible layout of the Lebara website on a laptop. If you click on the help or "Community" sections, the menu layout changes and the "Log Out" button completely disappears.
Even clicking the profile icon fails to show a sign-out option. It is a serious security risk and awful customer service to make it this difficult for a customer to secure their financial and personal account details. I was forced to close my browser and rely on an automatic safety timer just to log off. Lebara needs to fix this confusing website design immediately, so annoying!

reviews.title: Terrible customer service, broken PAC system and no response – Avoid Lebara!
reviews.body:
Last week I decided to leave Lebara and request my PAC code so I could transfer my number to another network. This is where the real frustration began.

Every available method has failed:

The website port-out form refuses to accept valid verification codes.

Texting PAC to 65075 returns an “Error with processing your request. Contact customer services”

I contacted customer service and asked them to generate my PAC code manually, but was told they could not do so over the phone.

I submitted a formal complaint on Wednesday, 7 October, and was promised a resolution within 48 hours. That deadline passed without any resolution.

I was then asked to wait another 48–72 hours for the Higher Network Team to investigate. After the weekend, the issue remained unresolved. A live chat adviser admitted that the backend error was an internal issue affecting multiple customers and requested yet another 24–48 hours for a callback.

The most frustrating part came next. Another agent Akshansh told me the problem had been fixed at midnight on Saturday and that their manager had sent my PAC code, which should arrive within 30 minutes. Nothing arrived. When I contacted customer service again, I was told the problem still existed and that it could take several more days, with no clear resolution date.

I was also asked to provide an alternative phone number because agents supposedly could not reach me. This makes no sense, as I had already received calls from Lebara on both Thursday and Friday.

To make matters worse, my emails have also been left unanswered. Despite making repeated attempts to resolve this issue through customer service, live chat, telephone calls and a formal complaint, I have received neither a proper response nor a meaningful resolution.

How can a mobile provider prevent customers from leaving because its own systems do not work, then repeatedly provide contradictory information and unrealistic promises?

Under Ofcom’s General Condition C7, customers have rights regarding number portability, and PAC requests are subject to strict requirements. 

I have now reached the end of my patience. If Lebara does not provide my PAC code over the phone and properly address my complaint, I will escalate the matter to the Communications Ombudsman and report the issue to Ofcom.

reviews.title: My plan was CANCELLED without request, and Customer Service HANG UP ON ME when I follow up a total of £15 credit DISAPPEARED without spending AGAIN
reviews.body:
After I posted my previous review on Trustpilot on 2 October, a member of Lebara's team called me on 2 October and reinstated the £10 goodwill credit originally provided by the Travel eSIM team on 26 August. I was also assured that my upcoming October monthly bill would be deducted from this credit.

However, my October payment was still taken from my bank account. I therefore called again on 9 October to follow up on why the payment had not been deducted from my available credit. Following that call, my goodwill credit disappeared again, and my monthly plan was cancelled WITHOUT my request. I was left without mobile data.

On 13 October, I called three times to resolve the issue. I had paid £5 on 8 October for a 5GB monthly data plan. During these calls, the staff have repeatedly BLAMED the issue on me having used up my 5GB data allowance, while my records show that I had used only 1,015MB between the start of my 5GB plan on 8 October and my call on 13 October.

Subsequently, a member of staff initially offered me only a 2.5GB plan as 'COMPENSATION', instead of restoring my original package for 5GB. I repeatedly explained I PAID FOR the package (it should not be deemed as compensation), and the team eventually restored the 5GB plan.

However, when I tried to follow up on the 2nd issue regarding the missing goodwill credit, the staff member HANG UP the call TWICE without addressing my concerns.

Before 9 October, my account previously showed £15 in credit (outstanding £5 auto top-up and £10 goodwill credit). However, after 9 October, all my credit has gone and I still have NO EXPLANATION for what happened to the £10 goodwill credit that Lebara's Travel eSIM team confirmed was added to my account. The staff member repeatedly BLAMED me for spending my goodwill credit, which I DIDN'T, and there is no spending record, and my October bill was still paid from my bank account. They HANG UP ON ME TWICE when I tried to explain the situation on the call.

I find it extremely frustrating that staff continue to attribute these issues to my usage without providing any evidence to support their explanations. I expect Lebara to check the actual data usage and credit transaction records rather than repeatedly blaming me for the problem.

I have provided all relevant screenshots and supporting evidence and have also sent them to Lebara by email. I sincerely hope this matter can finally be investigated and resolved promptly, especially regarding the disappeared £10 goodwill credit.

This issue has remained unresolved since September despite repeated calls, emails and assurances from your staff. If Lebara cannot provide a final resolution, I will consider escalating my complaint to the Ombudsman.
